name: Forillon National Park
policyReason: The park invites visitors to enjoy its trails and beaches with their pet.
summary: Leashed dogs can use the trails and beaches and stay at all campgrounds.

excerpts.quote: Enjoy the park’s trails and beaches with your pet.
Your pet is welcome at all campgrounds, as well as in the oTENTik tent F-7 at Petit-Gaspé campground and B-101 at Des-Rosiers campground.

dogRules.text: Leash of 3 m or less at all times.
Dogs are not allowed inside service buildings.
Pets are welcome at all campgrounds and in oTENTiks F-7 (Petit-Gaspé) and B-101 (Des-Rosiers).
Keep pets leashed near seal pups; check pets for ticks after hikes.
Service animals are allowed throughout the park.
